archived_at.description: When conversation was archived (explicit null when active)

archived_by.description: User who archived it (explicit null when active)

muted.description: Whether this conversation is muted for current user

content_options.description: any, links_only, text_only, images_only, videos_only, or custom

encrypted_content.description: Base64 encoded encrypted blob (recipient copy or plaintext)

has_reactions.description: True when ≥1 reaction exists — avoids N+1 fetches on the client

recipient_keys.description: Map of user_id -> encrypted_key for multi-recipient

crosspost_origin_post_id.description: Reddit post ID or platform post ID

crosspost_origin_type.description: Crosspost information (if this post is a crosspost)

has_commented.description: true if authenticated user has top-level comment on this post

hub_id.description: Optional: only set for hub posts

target_subreddit.description: Subreddit association (for posts that belong to a subreddit context)

user_vote.description: User interaction (only populated when user is authenticated)

my_reaction_id.description:
MyReactionID is the ID of the requesting user's reaction for this emoji,
or nil if the viewer has not reacted. Required by clients to call the
DELETE /messages/{id}/reactions/{reaction_id} endpoint.

parent_reddit_comment_id.description: Reddit API comment ID this is replying to

omnichat_default_user_name.description: OmniChat global identity defaults for new conversations.

content_options.description: any, links_only, text_only, images_only, videos_only, custom

parent_comment_id.description: Local comment ID to reply to

parent_reddit_comment_id.description: Reddit API comment ID to reply to

reactions.description:
Reactions contains aggregated per-emoji reaction data, ordered by:
1) count descending (most popular first),
2) first-seen ascending,
3) emoji lexicographically.

total_unique_emoji.description: TotalUniqueEmoji is the number of distinct emoji types on this message (max 10).

users_truncated.description:
UsersTruncated is true when the combined per-emoji user lists exceed 500
entries and were capped. Individual reaction counts remain accurate.

auto_delete_after_seconds.description:
AutoDeleteAfterSeconds is the per-chat override in whole seconds.
nil means no per-chat override is set (conversation inherits global default).
0 would mean "never" but is never returned — nil is used instead.
